strings.mdKbSmart: • Vuku ni kato ni ki fetch: dikeva na kato ni ki ena gauna oqo me baleta na Google ni lisi ni vakasukai (CRL) ka tovolea e vuqa na ivurevure me yacova ni sa kunea e dua na kato ni ki dodonu, vata kei na dua na vakasukasuka vakataki koya kei na dua na tekivu tale ni Google veiqaravi. Cici ena veitabana kece ka gadreva na initaneti (1-3 na miniti).
strings.mdKbNet: • Kato ni ki mai na rede: lavetaka e dua na kato ni ki mai na vanua ni maroroi vakamatanitu (GitHub) ka maroroya ki na /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. E gadrevi na initaneti ka taura 1-3 na miniti. Vakayagataki ena gauna e sega ni rawata kina na fetch vuku se ena gauna e veisautaki kina na kato ni ki ena liga.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP diagnosis: checks the available Remote Key Provisioning modules, inspects the TEE attestation certificate version, and shows the KmInstallKeybox tool state. Changes nothing — a plain device status view.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine jeke (wili-ga): vakaraitaka Widevine ivakatakilakila ni ivakatagedegede (L1/L3) mai na dumpsys, DRM (IDM) ki-faile tiko, kei na iyau ni ivakarau ni veiwekani. E sega ni veisautaka e dua na ka.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. Fixes attestation issues when the automatic pass fails. Every run prints a clear success/failure line.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Full RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh full. Handles the hard cases and takes longer. A clear result appears at the end.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Vakavoutaka na GMS: vakasavasavataka na Play Store kei na Google veiqaravi (GMS+GSF) itukutuku ka vakavoutaka na misini vakataki koya. Me baleta na veivakadeitaki kaukauwa duadua ga — e sega vakadua ni tara na nomu itaba se faile.
strings.mdCertify: • Play certification: checks the RKP certificate attestation state of the device and resets the attestation properties if needed. Does not touch user data.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER vakavinakataki: vakavinakataka na Google ituvatuva ni veiqaravi (SOTER) na veika e baleta na veivakadeitaki ni misini. Vakayagataki me baleta na iyaya eso ka vakararavi ena SOTER ka sega ni qito dina.
strings.mdPifApply: • Apply PIF: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh force. Applies the selected fingerprint (local/advanced) and updates the pif.prop/pif.json files. A clear result appears in the log.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF vakadeitaka: vakaraitaka na ituvaki ni idini vakacurumi, na faile ni iqaqalo (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), kei na itukutuku. Raica ga — e sega ni veisautaka e dua na ka.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary update: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Fetches the latest Canary Engine release to ensure compatibility with the mandatory RKP certificates (February 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Engine diagnosis: checks the TrickyStoreOSS state (pid, logs), the keybox files (active vs user), the real vs spoofed device fingerprint, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP keys. Diagnostic display only.
strings.panelKbSlots: 🔐 Slots de caja de clave (primaria / secundaria)
strings.hintKbSlots: Na module e qarava e rua na slots ni kato ni ki: na imatai (tabu, sega vakadua ni bokoci) kei na ikarua (vakasukai). Na tabana oqo e vakaraitaka na slot cava e cakacaka tiko, veisautaka na gagadre, se vakatorocaketaka na ikarua ki na imatai ena kerekere matata — vata kei na backups kei na dua na itukutuku taucoko.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Dikevi ni yalodina: vakadikeva na TEE ki ni vakacuru ilavo, na valenivolavola ni veivakabulabulataki ena loma ni sitoa ni ki2, na ituvaki ni veivakasukai (CRL), na veitaqomaki-lisi ni veivakabulabulataki kei na RKP ituvaki. Wilika-ga — e sega ni veisautaka e dua na ka.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Taqomaki tale vakayagataki:

• Na lisi ni veitaqomaki e tara tale mai na app kece e vakacurumi.
• Na ituvatuva ni veiganiti ni itovo-ROM e vakayagataki tale.
• Na kato ni ki gugumatua e vakayagataki tale. tekivu tale.

E sega ni dua na ka e bokoci ka sega vakadua ni tara na kato ni ki taumada.

Tomani?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Ki slots: vakaraitaka na ituvaki ni imatai kei na ikarua ni slots ka veisautaka na gagadre ena kedrau maliwa. Na imatai (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) e dau taqomaki ka sega vakadua ni bokoci. Na kena vakatorocaketaki na ikarua ki na imatai e gadrevi kina na veivakadeitaki matata.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Vakatorocaketaka na ikarua ni slot ki na imatai:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml yaco me na itukutuku ni imatai ni slot.
• Na imatai ni gauna oqo e maroroi me vaka e dua na itukutuku ni bera ni veisautaki.
• E sega ni dua na ka e bokoci — na cakacaka e rawa ni vakasukai.
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Vakasavasavataka na ikarua ni vanua:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml ena kau laivi.
• Na vanua taumada e sega ni tara.

Tomana?
